description: Military Construction/VA appropriations bill, Senate reported print. This is a PUBLISHED GPO print whose XML this repository deliberately withholds while #434 is open (see the note in tests/corpus_manifest.toml); it is NOT a draft and is not PDF-only upstream, so it is not evidence about draft-PDF extraction and does not close #6. It is the only committed version with no XML available, and so the only place this recall claim is not already made by test_pdf_xml_amount_recall.py. Values below were transcribed from the rendered pages (Title I, printed pages 2-10), not from extractor output, so the fixture is an oracle independent of the code it gates.
